description: Choose what to scrape — item pages, a seller store inventory, one store category, or keyword search — then set marketplace and result limits.

buyingFormat.description: Show only Buy It Now or auction listings in keyword-search results.
buyingFormat.title: Buying format

condition.description: Filter keyword-search results by condition. Leave on All conditions for every condition.
condition.title: Item condition

freeShipping.description: Keep only keyword-search results that advertise free shipping or delivery.
freeShipping.title: Free shipping only

includeItemDetails.description: When on, every discovered listing is opened and returns the full item record (specifics, images, seller, shipping, returns). Turn off for a faster card-level result from search and store pages.
includeItemDetails.title: Open each listing for full item details

includeItemSpecifics.description: Add the full item-specifics table (brand, model, MPN, dimensions, features and other aspects) to item records.
includeItemSpecifics.title: Include the item-specifics table

itemIds.description: eBay item IDs (for example 257633093777) or full /itm/ links. Used in Item details mode.
itemIds.title: Item IDs or URLs

itemLocation.description: Keep keyword-search results located in the marketplace country, or show worldwide results.
itemLocation.title: Item location

marketplace.description: Country site used for names and keywords, and for any input that is not already a full URL. The dropdown carries the legacy full-URL values; short codes (US, GB, DE, FR, IT, ES, CA, AU) are also accepted by API callers.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

maxItems.description: Upper limit on item records across every source.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPages.description: Stop after this many listing pages per store, category or search. Each page holds up to 240 listings.
maxPages.title: Max pages per source

maxPrice.description: Filter keyword-search results by maximum item price in the marketplace's local currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

minPrice.description: Filter keyword-search results by minimum item price in the marketplace's local currency.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

mode.description: Item details opens the item pages you list. Store inventory walks a seller's whole store. Store category walks one category inside a store. Keyword search finds matching listings.
enumTitles: Item details — open specific item pages
Store inventory — every active listing in a seller store
Store category — one category inside a seller store
Keyword search — listings matching your terms
mode.title: What to scrape

returnsAccepted.description: Keep only keyword-search results that accept returns.
returnsAccepted.title: Returns accepted only

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on the selected marketplace. One search per entry. Used in Keyword search mode.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

startUrls.description: Paste item, store, store-category, category-browse or search links and each is routed to the right mode automatically. Ignored when the arrays above already cover that source.
startUrls.title: Paste any eBay URLs (optional shortcut)

storeCategoryUrls.description: Store-category links copied from a store page, for example https://www.ebay.com/str/mystore/Laptops/_i.html?store_cat=1234567890. Used in Store category mode.
storeCategoryUrls.title: Store category URLs

storeNames.description: Seller store names (for example discountcomputerdepot) or /str/ store links. Used in Store inventory mode.
storeNames.title: Store names or URLs

title: eBay Item, Store & Store Category Detail Input
